refresh_policy: Verified against vendor pricing pages by the HostFleet data agent. Target cadence: Monday and Thursday.

providers.name: Fal.ai
providers.billing: per-hour list price for custom deployments; committed-use discounts advertised

providers.name: Lambda Cloud
providers.billing: per-hour on-demand GPU instances; prices vary by instance GPU count

providers.name: CoreWeave Inference
providers.billing: per-hour single-GPU inference rate; inference platform customers only (contact account executive)

providers.name: Nebius AI Cloud
providers.billing: per-second VM compute, shown as on-demand GPU-hour; H100/H200/B200/B300/RTX PRO rates include prescribed vCPU and RAM, while L40S is the minimum all-in 1-GPU preset

providers.name: Hyperstack
providers.billing: per-minute on-demand GPU VM, shown per GPU-hour; fixed CPU, RAM, root disk, and ephemeral disk are included, while public IPs and shared storage are separate

providers.name: Novita AI
providers.billing: per-second on-demand GPU instance, settled hourly; listed one-GPU compute prices include the product's fixed vCPU and RAM, with storage above the free container-disk quota billed separately

providers.name: Verda (formerly DataCrunch)
providers.billing: prepaid pay-as-you-go GPU instances in 10-minute increments, with unused terminated time refunded in the next billing period; listed one-GPU price includes fixed CPU and RAM, while storage is separate

providers.name: Salad Container Engine
providers.billing: per-second managed container instances at Lowest (formerly Batch) priority; GPU rates include selected vCPU and RAM, allocation and image-download time are unbilled, and distributed nodes are interruptible

providers.name: Vultr Cloud GPU
providers.billing: hourly on-demand GPU instances using actual calendar-month hours; listed instance rates include fixed vCPU, RAM, local storage, and outbound bandwidth allocations, and stopped instances continue billing until destroyed
